typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ReportName as string ('pfoxd105d vSphere World'),
	HostConfigAPI_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Name as string,
		{Interval Breakdown} as string,
		Model as string,
		Cluster as string,
		GPUs as string,
		{Running VMs} as string,
		{Total Cores} as string,
		{CPU Total Capacity (MHZ)} as string,
		{CPU Usage (MHZ)} as string,
		{Allocated VCPUs} as string,
		{Powered on vCPUs} as string,
		{CPU - P99} as string,
		{CPU - P95} as string,
		{CPU - P75} as string,
		{CPU - P50} as string,
		{CPU - Max} as string,
		{CPU - Average} as string,
		{CPU Contention %} as string,
		{CPU Provisioned MHZ} as string,
		{Memory - Total} as string,
		{Allocated Memory (GB)} as string,
		{Powered on Memory (GB)} as string,
		{Memory - Utilization (GB)} as string,
		{Memory - P99} as string,
		{Memory - P95} as string,
		{Memory - P75} as string,
		{Memory - P50} as string,
		{Memory - Max} as string,
		{Memory - Average} as string,
		{Memory - Balloon} as string,
		{Memory Contention %} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> hostconfigurationAPI
hostconfigurationAPI derive(report_name = toString($ReportName),
		importdate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		{CPU_-_Max} as string,
		GPUs as string,
		{Memory_-_P95} as string,
		Running_VMs as string,
		{Memory_-_P75} as string,
		CPU_Provisioned_MHZ as string,
		{Memory_-_Total} as string,
		{Memory_-_P50} as string,
		Name as string,
		{CPU_-_P95} as string,
		Allocated_Memory__GB_ as string,
		{CPU_-_P50} as string,
		{CPU_-_P99} as string,
		{Memory_-_Average} as string,
		{CPU_-_P75} as string,
		{Memory_-_Balloon} as string,
		{CPU_-_Average} as string,
		CPU_Contention__ as string,
		Total_Cores as string,
		{Memory_-_Max} as string,
		Powered_on_vCPUs as string,
		Memory_Contention__ as string,
		Interval_Breakdown as string,
		Cluster as string,
		CPU_Total_Capacity__MHZ_ as string,
		{Memory_-_Utilization__GB_} as string,
		Allocated_VCPUs as string,
		Powered_on_Memory__GB_ as string,
		{Memory_-_P99} as string,
		Model as string,
		CPU_Usage__MHZ_ as string,
		report_name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		{CPU_-_Max} = {CPU - Max},
		GPUs,
		{Memory_-_P95} = {Memory - P95},
		Running_VMs = {Running VMs},
		{Memory_-_P75} = {Memory - P75},
		CPU_Provisioned_MHZ = {CPU Provisioned MHZ},
		{Memory_-_Total} = {Memory - Total},
		{Memory_-_P50} = {Memory - P50},
		Name,
		{CPU_-_P95} = {CPU - P95},
		Allocated_Memory__GB_ = {Allocated Memory (GB)},
		{CPU_-_P50} = {CPU - P50},
		{CPU_-_P99} = {CPU - P99},
		{Memory_-_Average} = {Memory - Average},
		{CPU_-_P75} = {CPU - P75},
		{Memory_-_Balloon} = {Memory - Balloon},
		{CPU_-_Average} = {CPU - Average},
		CPU_Contention__ = {CPU Contention %},
		Total_Cores = {Total Cores},
		{Memory_-_Max} = {Memory - Max},
		Powered_on_vCPUs = {Powered on vCPUs},
		Memory_Contention__ = {Memory Contention %},
		Interval_Breakdown = {Interval Breakdown},
		Cluster,
		CPU_Total_Capacity__MHZ_ = {CPU Total Capacity (MHZ)},
		{Memory_-_Utilization__GB_} = {Memory - Utilization (GB)},
		Allocated_VCPUs = {Allocated VCPUs},
		Powered_on_Memory__GB_ = {Powered on Memory (GB)},
		{Memory_-_P99} = {Memory - P99},
		Model,
		CPU_Usage__MHZ_ = {CPU Usage (MHZ)},
		report_name),
	partitionFileNames:[($HostConfigAPI_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> HostConfigAPI
